goal:
T62 — EvoCore strategy promotion (v3.8 §5: Route -> Verify -> Evolve -> Promote; product line "AI that evolves how AI
builds"). In services/api/evoforge/evolution_rounds.py + services/api/main.py:
1. Strategy = {"max_attempts": int 1..3, "accumulate_critic": bool, "retire_stale": bool} (exactly these keys; anything
   else, missing keys or wrong types -> 422). DEFAULT = {max_attempts: 3, accumulate_critic: true, retire_stale: true}
   (today's behaviour). strategy_id = "st_" + first 10 hex chars of sha256(json.dumps(strategy, sort_keys=True,
   separators=(",", ":"))).
2. POST /v1/evolution/runs accepts optional "strategy". Omitted -> the current champion strategy. The EvoForge lane
   uses it: max_attempts caps attempts per round; accumulate_critic false = T53 off (only this round's Critic tests);
   retire_stale false = T57 off. The run document stores "strategy" and "strategy_id"; manifest gets strategy_id and
   strategy. Runs stored without a strategy count as DEFAULT.
3. GET /v1/evolution/strategies -> {champion: {strategy_id, strategy, since}, candidates: [{strategy_id, strategy, runs,
   evoforge: {rounds, verified, wilson95}}] (finished runs only, EvoForge side, same counting and Wilson helper as
   /v1/evolution/stats), decisions: [...] oldest first}. With no decision the champion is DEFAULT.
4. POST /v1/evolution/strategies/promote {strategy_id}: unknown id (no finished run used it) -> 404; promote only when
   the candidate's EvoForge wilson95 lower bound > the champion's upper bound (champion with no rounds counts as
   [0, 0]); otherwise 409 with a reason that says the intervals overlap. On success store a decision {promoted,
   previous, candidate_interval, champion_interval, at} in the evidence store (kind "strategy_decision", survives
   redeploys) and make it the champion for new runs. Promoting the champion itself -> 409.
5. evolution_rounds.clear() also resets the champion and decisions (tests rely on it).
6. Proxy: allow GET /v1/evolution/strategies and POST /v1/evolution/strategies/promote (proxyPolicy.ts + cases).
Nothing else changes. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t62.py.
